title: URL fragments bypass non-live loopback admission
claim: Non-live resolution accepts http://example.invalid#@localhost (and #@127.0.0.1) as loopback although the actual HTTP URL host is example.invalid. The shared guard therefore does not enforce the default remote-route rejection boundary.

evidence.detail: Authority is split only on / or ?, then rsplit @; a fragment becomes a false host. The same gate at line 738 guards hermetic and native-fixture modes.
Native handoff retains the selected projected endpoint; prepare_native does not add endpoint validation.
Harbor setup copies/verifies projected config but provides no independent URL-fragment/remote-host rejection before selected client dispatch.
Exact locked url 2.5.8 probe returns host=example.invalid, fragment=@localhost; opi-ai Anthropic HTTP request consumes the URL through the HTTP parser.
Strongest counter-evidence: ordinary remote endpoints are rejected. Private native-fixture CLI probe confirms control exit 1 and fragment exit 0; the test does not cover fragment authorities.
Pier network_allowlist rejects fragments, so this finding does not claim DeepSWE egress bypass or an observed remote request.
Built binary SHA-256 a84d8017cdb48f6ad26755c9658b2ced24d5dd0deaf4562d07189cd3000a8d55. Hermetic and native-fixture validation accept the fragment; no Agent/provider/network effect was launched.

reproduction: Replace base_url in local-paired.toml with http://example.invalid#@localhost; opi-eval validate --config C accepts with exit 0 in hermetic and native-fixture modes.
Locked-url probe: http://example.invalid#@localhost => host_str Some(example.invalid), fragment Some(@localhost).

title: Trial expansion allocates before enforcing max_trials
claim: A valid positive repetition count can force enormous plan allocation despite max_trials=1 because expand_selection checks the cap only after constructing every trial. The public plan CLI aborts under a bounded memory limit instead of returning the required bound rejection.

evidence.detail: Nested selected task/repetition/subject loops push into Vec before the max_trials comparison at line 449.
Positive repetitions up to u32::MAX are admitted.

One task, two subjects, repetitions 4294967295, max_trials 1, RLIMIT_AS 256 MiB and no core dump: returncode -6 in 0.82s, memory allocation failed, no plan file. Repetitions 2 returns exit 2 with planned count 4 exceeds max_trials 1.

Strongest counter-evidence: cap tests reject small explicit/selected lists before native dispatch; they do not bound cardinality calculation/allocation. The shared run_experiment check is also downstream of expansion.
